A [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned, yellow-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], quadripedal species of '''creatures''' with long snouts lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bri'ahl]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], one such creature considered eating the discarded head of the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], but ultimately decided against it and tossed the head down a hill.
